Done! I've implemented all three functions:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric/dash characters
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, parses the JSON array, logs the user count, and returns the array

All functions are exported and ready to use.
